calls.name: set_macro_plan

args.summary: Build from a solid 38-42 km/wk base to peak for a sub-1:45 half marathon on Oct 4. Four phases: Base (maintain aerobic volume), Build (add volume + second quality session), Peak (race-specific tempo and long runs to 20-22 km), Taper (reduce volume, keep intensity). Strength 2x/week throughout, dropping heavy legs in race week.

phases.name: Base
phases.focus: Maintain aerobic volume and threshold baseline; strengthen aerobic engine
phases.notes: Hold ~38-42 km/wk, one threshold session, long run 16-18 km. Strength 2x/week.

phases.name: Build
phases.focus: Increase weekly volume toward 48-50 km; add a second quality session (intervals or tempo)
phases.notes: Long run builds to 19-20 km. Threshold + intervals/tempo. Strength 2x/week.

phases.name: Peak
phases.focus: Race-specific work: HM-pace tempo blocks, long runs to 20-22 km with race-pace segments
phases.notes: Peak volume ~50 km. Long run max 22 km. Include 2-3 km at goal pace (4:58/km) within tempos. Strength 2x/week, reduce lower-body volume in final 2 weeks.

phases.name: Taper
phases.focus: Reduce volume 40-60% over 3 weeks while keeping intensity sharp
phases.notes: Week 1 taper: ~35 km. Week 2: ~25 km. Race week: ~15 km with a short sharp session. Drop heavy legs entirely race week. Race Oct 4.

days.detail: Heavy lower-body session. Keep RPE 7-8. Prioritise depth and control on squats.

exercises.name: Back Squat (Barbell)
exercises.note: Add 2.5 kg if all reps clean

days.title: Easy 6 km recovery
days.detail: Easy aerobic run @ 5:40-6:00/km. Keep HR in Z2. Shake out legs after yesterday's strength session.

days.title: Easy 7 km

days.title: Upper body — push/pull
days.detail: Upper-body strength session. Keep RPE 7. This won't impact tomorrow's long run.

exercises.name: Bench Press (Barbell)
exercises.note: Add 2.5 kg if all reps clean

days.title: Long run 16 km
days.detail: Easy long run @ 5:50-6:00/km. HR Z2. Practice fueling — take a gel at 45 min. Finish strong.

args.summary: Build from a solid 38 km aerobic base to a sub-50 10K on Nov 8. Progress volume to ~50 km, extend the long run to 20 km, and layer in race-pace intervals (5:00/km) and threshold work. Taper in the final week with reduced volume but race-pace touches to stay sharp.

phases.name: Base
phases.focus: Aerobic volume build — extend long run to 20 km, push weekly volume to 45–50 km, maintain one threshold session/week
phases.notes: Keep easy runs easy (5:35–5:50/km). Progress long run by 1–2 km every other week.

phases.name: Build
phases.focus: Introduce 10K race-pace intervals at 5:00/km, progress threshold to 20-min continuous, hold volume 48–52 km
phases.notes: Add 6×1K @ 5:00/km progressing to 5×2K @ race pace. One threshold run, one long run, rest easy.

phases.name: Peak
phases.focus: 10K-specific sharpening — 5K pace intervals, race-pace tempo blocks, peak long run ~20 km
phases.notes: Key workout: 3×3K @ 5:00/km. Add strides 2x/week. Keep strength but reduce lower-body volume.

phases.name: Taper
phases.focus: Reduce volume 40–50%, maintain race-pace touches, drop heavy legs
phases.notes: No heavy lifting race week. One short race-pace tune-up midweek.

phases.name: Race
phases.notes: Target pace 5:00/km. Negative split strategy — go out at 5:05 for first 3K, settle to 5:00, finish hard.

phases.name: Build
phases.focus: Increase volume and intensity — longer threshold blocks, race-pace work in long runs
phases.notes: Long run grows to 20k with 6-8k at goal pace. Threshold sessions extend to 6-7k total work. Peak week 55k.

phases.name: Peak
phases.focus: Race-specific endurance — long runs with extended goal-pace segments, sharpening intervals
phases.notes: Long runs with 10-12k at goal pace. VO2max work introduced (e.g. 6×800m). Strength shifts to maintenance.

phases.name: Taper
phases.focus: Absorb training, arrive fresh and sharp
phases.notes: Volume drops ~40% then ~60%. Keep intensity but cut volume. No heavy legs in final 10 days. Race Oct 4.

phases.notes: Cut volume ~40% first week, ~60% race week. Keep short sharp efforts. No heavy legs in final 10 days.

phases.name: Race
phases.notes: Go out at 4:58-5:00/km, negative split if feeling strong.
